note: Election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1946: six contests, 21 unopposed returns, and no nominations for Ballymoyer and Derrymore. The Frontier Sentinel prints no party labels. Polled 3 October 1946. Patrick Trainor: no party label printed in 1946. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Creggan, 25 May 1939, printed 'Nat.': Belfast News-Letter, 27 May 1939, p. 9 ("Local Elections: Surprise in Armagh County Council Contest") ("Newry No. 2 Rural Council"); nominations from the Frontier Sentinel, 20 May 1939, p. 5) and as Anti-Partitionist (Creggan, 2 June 1949, printed 'Anti-Partitionist': Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (election nominations)"); Frontier Sentinel, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry and Kilkeel Rural Councils' Nominations")).
